task.title: Continue explicitly after one provider tool step
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/563 by making ProviderRequired actionable through one explicit caller-owned provider continuation.
acceptance_criteria: Add a continuation-provider trait without changing existing provider or runtime behavior.
Expose the exact successful prior tool result and call the continuation provider exactly once.
Return Complete for final content or dispatch at most one subsequent tool request with a fresh caller-owned invocation identity.
Keep exact tool values in memory, durable evidence metadata-only, and every failure typed and source-preserving without retry or an automatic loop.

attempts.summary: Established RED for an explicit provider continuation.
attempts.diagnostic: The focused continuation target failed on the missing continuation provider, context, and runtime operation.
attempts.patch: Kept tests for exact prior-result delivery, final response, one subsequent request with fresh identity, provider failure ordering, exact call counts, and metadata-only retention.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored one explicit continuation step.
attempts.diagnostic: A borrowed continuation context supplies exact prior tool data to one provider call; final content completes, while a subsequent request reuses durable task associated dispatch and returns another ProviderRequired value.
attempts.patch: Added the additive continuation trait and operation, then extracted shared response dispatch so initial and continued steps preserve one implementation of lookup, authorization, persistence, and result shaping.

attempts.summary: Verified and merged the caller-controlled continuation slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused continuation tests and pinned just verify passed. GitHub Rust quality gate run 30132026503 succeeded; CodeRabbit reported adaptive review limiting rather than a substantive review.
attempts.patch: Pull request 564 squash-merged as f957649cb48cd48d30044c0d86f9697bb479c24e and closed issue 563.

outcome.summary: A successful provider tool step can now be continued explicitly for one more provider response and at most one fresh durable tool invocation.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test provider_tool_continuation

lessons: Caller-controlled one-step continuation makes provider and tool call counts explicit and avoids hiding retries or loops.
Borrowing prior tool data can preserve exact in-memory context without widening durable retention.
Initial and continued provider responses should share one dispatch helper so lookup, permission, and persistence ordering cannot drift.
Fresh durable identity and authorization remain caller responsibilities for every subsequent tool request.
